dedupe_keys.name: new hospital programme england annual data tables schemes waves construction start dates funding cost ranges and locations dhsc 2025 to 2026

description: These DHSC data tables track England's New Hospital Programme, the government's plan to rebuild or replace hospitals, including those built with crumbling reinforced autoclaved aerated concrete (RAAC). The 2025 to 2026 workbook, published in July 2026 alongside the programme's annual report, lists 46 schemes with their wave, from schemes already under construction to wave 3, construction start dates, business case status, funding received so far and lower and upper total cost estimates in pounds million. A separate sheet gives each scheme's NHS region and coordinates, so the planned hospitals can be mapped. The workbook is free to download as an ODS spreadsheet from GOV.UK, and the programme's origin is set out in the 2019 Health Infrastructure Plan, which named the first six schemes and 21 trusts given seed funding. Coverage is England, with construction starts running into the late 2030s after the 2025 programme review. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): OGL-UK-3.0 (GOV.UK site-wide statement: all content available under OGL v3.0 except where otherwise stated). Simulation uses: future hospital locations and timing for healthcare capacity and access scenarios, and investment figures for resilience appraisal. Related records: the NHP demand model (model-nhp-demand-model) is the tool used to size these new hospitals. The underlying files were not downloaded, so their contents are not verified here.
